topic.title: Generating AST
topic.shortdesc: Installing the org.dita-bootstrap.ast plug-in, generating Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) JSON topic files using the ast-bootstrap transtype, configuring custom header and footer build parameters, and publishing into the document store.

section.title: Plug-in Overview & Installation
section.p: The org.dita-bootstrap.ast plug-in transforms DITA XML source topics into JSON Abstract Syntax Trees (AST). Install the plug-in into your DITA Open Toolkit instance:
section.codeblock: # Install plug-ins using the dita command: dita install fox.jason.extend.css dita install org.dita-bootstrap.ast

section.title: Publishing AST to the Document Store
section.p: Publishing a DITA map to JSON AST requires a single DITA-OT execution command using the ast-bootstrap transformation type:
section.codeblock: # Publish documentation directly into the data store directory: dita --input=path/to/your.ditamap \ --format=ast-bootstrap \ --output=data-store/data/my-doc-set
section.p: The output directory contains toc.json alongside AST JSON topic files. Once published, data-store automatically discovers the document set and adds it to the catalog.

section.title: Customizing Headers & Footers via Build Parameters
section.p: Custom navigation headers and footers can be attached at publish time using the --args.hdr and --args.ftr build parameters:
You can reference the following existing XML include files provided by the plug-in suite as functional examples:

ul.li: hdr.navbar.example.xml — Example top navigation bar layout template.
hdr.sidebar.example.xml — Example sidebar header layout template.
hdr.topbar.example.xml — Example top bar header layout template.
ftr.content.example.xml — Example multi-column social and copyright footer layout template.

section.title: Detailed Structure of Default Navigation Header (hdr.navbar.default.xml)
section.p: The plug-in includes hdr.navbar.default.xml as the default primary header template. Its XML structure demonstrates how Bootstrap components, placeholders, and interactive roles are compiled into AST nodes:
section.codeblock: Light Dark Auto
section.p: Key structural elements of hdr.navbar.default.xml include:

plentry.pd: Defines a fixed top Bootstrap navigation bar with dark styling (data-bs-theme="dark", bg="primary", sticky="top").

ul.li: document-title/ — XML placeholder element automatically substituted at publish time with the document map title.
favicon/ — Placeholder element replaced by the branding favicon icon.
role="search" — Placed on the search Form; compiled into AST and intercepted by the web renderer to mount the live client-side search box.
role="theme-toggle" — Placed on the NavDropdown; intercepted by the web renderer to mount the interactive Light/Dark theme switcher.

section.title: AST Directory & File Structure
section.p: When publishing with --format=ast-bootstrap, DITA-OT creates the target directory containing:

ul.li: toc.json — Manifest file describing document title, navigation structure, language metadata, header AST layout, and topic hierarchy.
Topic JSON files (e.g., index.json, getting-started.json) — Serialized tuple arrays representing React component trees ([type, props?, ...children]).
